business.name: Himal Product and Services
business.tagline: Everyday electronics repair and products in Eastern Nepal
business.description: A repair workshop and electronics shop in Sundarharaincha, Morang, serving Itahari, Sunsari, Morang and the wider Koshi region. Contact the shop to confirm repair availability, current product stock and delivery arrangements.

address.location_note: The workshop is in Sundarharaincha, Morang, on the Itahari–Biratnagar corridor. Confirm directions and service availability before travelling.

design.direction: Premium, clear local electronics retailer and repair workshop; practical and human, not a generic technology startup
design.typography: System sans-serif stack; clear headings with a 1.2–1.3 line-height, body text at least 16px with about 1.5 line-height.
design.layout: Mobile first; centered content width around 1180px; white cards on cool light blue-grey backgrounds; 16px card radius; generous spacing; no horizontal overflow.
design.interaction: Touch targets at least 44px, visible keyboard focus, clear form labels and inline errors, subtle hover elevation, brief purposeful motion, honor reduced-motion preference.
design.imagery: Use the actual shop/workbench, brand logo, and relevant product photos. Avoid repeating unrelated stock images. Use optimized WebP/AVIF where supported, meaningful alt text and reserved image aspect ratios.

commerce.current_order_flow: The current site provides a product enquiry/COD request, then opens WhatsApp with order details for the shop to confirm stock, delivery cost and final total.
payment_methods: Store pickup; payment confirmed by the shop
commerce.online_payment: No live eSewa or card gateway is confirmed in the current website. Add a Nepal-supported gateway only after the merchant account and keys are configured and tested.
commerce.delivery_policy: Confirm destination, item, stock, delivery charge and estimated arrival with the shop before promising delivery. Product courier and repair courier-in arrangements depend on destination and item.

media.import_note: Upload these files to WordPress Media Library; reselect them in each product, repair and article record rather than retaining Next.js /images paths.
